reason: The D-2/Q-1 preset control (a second role=radiogroup with three native <input type=radio>) makes locked tests fail that Q-2/Q-3 do not cover. Two of them belong to owners that were not unlocked (TASK-2.4, TASK-2.3). The third is home.acceptance's exact input list, which needs a change other than a name, style label or row order. No markup that meets SPEC-01/D-2 (native radios in a radiogroup) can pass these assertions unchanged.
evidence: With the spec's design applied (configForLineUp/botsClockwise in session.ts, radiogroup in GameConfigScreen), `npx vitest run` on the three files gives 5 failed / 3 passed. tests/ui/game-config-game-type.acceptance.test.tsx (TASK-2.4, locked, not unlocked): :37 `groups` toHaveLength(1) gets 2; :60 checkedValues(html) toEqual(['sit-and-go']) gets ['sit-and-go','Mixed'] (page-wide radio scan); :78 inputs toEqual([true,true]) gets 5 trues. tests/ui/game-config-stake.acceptance.test.tsx:71 (TASK-2.3, locked, not unlocked): all <input> must be [true,true], gets 5. tests/ui/home.acceptance.test.tsx:79-84 (TASK-2.1, unlocked for routine edits only): html.match(/<(input|select|textarea)[\s>]/g) toEqual(['<input ','<input ','<select ','<select ']) would need three more '<input ' entries. That is not a name/style label/row order edit. The spec prototype had no radio control, so it did not show these failures. Partial e2e:slow run (stopped once the block was found, before the 200-hand test finished): 14 passed, 0 failed across rapid-pace and responsive-table in Chromium and WebKit.
options: A (recommended): approve routine 'new control' edits that keep every assertion. game-type test: select the group by aria-labelledby="config-game-type" (count of game-type groups stays 1), scope checkedValues to name="game-type", and expect [true,true,true,true,true] radios (or scope to the game-type group). stake test :71 and home :79-84: expect the three extra radio inputs. Unlock TASK-2.4 tests/ui/game-config-game-type.acceptance.test.tsx and TASK-2.3 tests/ui/game-config-stake.acceptance.test.tsx, and widen Q-2 for home.acceptance.

B: change Q-1/D-2 to a <select id="config-lineup"> in the Opponents panel. game-type/stake input assertions then pass unchanged, but home.acceptance's input list (+1 '<select ') and stake's selects(html) toHaveLength(2) (:69) still need edits, so it still needs an unlock decision
C: put the preset control on a later screen/step (out of AC#1's 'Game Config ... Mixed preset is selected'); not recommended
